findings.title: Migration interpolates host value into raw SQL
findings.body: File db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb builds INSERT with string interpolation of the old site_settings value: VALUES ('#{h}', ...). A host containing a single quote breaks the migration and allows SQL injection. The value comes from user-controlled site settings and must be quoted/sanitized or inserted via ActiveRecord, not string interpolation.

findings.title: Migration crashes if embed_category settings are missing
findings.body: File db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb assumes SELECT queries always return a row and indexes [0]['id'] / [0]['value'] unconditionally. On a fresh install or when embed_category / uncategorized_category_id / embeddable_hosts rows are absent, [0] is nil and the migration raises NoMethodError, blocking db:migrate. Guard for empty results.

findings.title: Update/destroy dereference nil when host not found
findings.body: File app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb does EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first then calls save_host(host) or host.destroy without checking for nil. An unknown id causes NoMethodError and a 500 instead of 404. The same applies to destroy. Return not-found when the record is missing.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: File app/models/embeddable_host.rb calls self.host.sub! twice in before_validation without guarding nil. If host is nil or blank, this raises NoMethodError before format validation can run, turning a validation error into an exception in Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host.

findings.title: Host lookup is case-sensitive and ignores port stripping
findings.body: File app/models/embeddable_host.rb queries where("lower(host) = ?", host) with the raw URI host value. The column is lowered but the parameter is not downcased, so mixed-case referers fail to match. It also compares URI.host (no port) against a column that can contain a port, so hosts stored with :port never match. Downcase the parameter and normalize ports on both sides.

findings.title: Only first underscore is normalized for admin check
findings.body: File app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6 uses type.replace('_','-') which replaces only the first underscore. Any model type with multiple underscores will fail the ADMIN_MODELS check and use the wrong base path. Use a global replace.

findings.title: Plural embedded ids crash on null or contain undefined
findings.body: File app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6 in _hydrateEmbedded assumes any key ending in _ids is an array and calls obj[k].map directly. If the payload has null, missing, or singular values, this throws. Even when it is an array, failed lookups insert undefined entries without filtering. Guard for non-arrays and compact missing lookups.

findings.title: Fabricator files have swapped contents
findings.body: File spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb now defines only Fabricator(:embeddable_host) while spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb defines the category fabricators. The contents are swapped relative to filenames. It works only because all fabricators are loaded globally, but it is confusing and will break anyone requiring files by name. Put each fabricator in its matching file.

findings.title: No coverage for new admin embedding endpoints
findings.body: Files spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb and spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb only assert subclassing and never exercise create/update/destroy/show, validation errors, auth, or not-found paths. The new controllers and migration logic that replaces site settings are untested and regressions like nil handling would not be caught.
